terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

formLanguage: rectilinear masses with restrained organic wood variation
objectClass.notes: The reference clearly shows one isolated desk from a front-right three-quarter view plus knob and tabletop-corner close-ups. The back, drawer interiors, and exact dimensions are not visible; hidden geometry may follow bilateral furniture symmetry and conventional shallow drawer construction without changing the visible design language.

reasoning: The recognizable silhouette depends on a thick overhanging rounded tabletop, a shallow drawer cabinet, four long tapered legs, and open negative space below the apron.
The front hierarchy contains one wide center drawer flanked by two narrower drawers, with independent fronts, shadow gaps, slides, and brass knobs.
Fidelity depends on directionally correct wood grain, edge-darkened wood response, low-relief drawer seams, softened solid-wood edges, and aged brass rather than on raw polygon count alone.
Four legs and three knob assemblies require controlled repetition while preserving small positional and material variation.

The single view is sufficient for visible reconstruction because the object is conventional furniture and the close-ups resolve the two highest-risk details: the knob profile and tabletop corner treatment.

specDepthDecision.rationale: A generic slab-and-four-boxes model cannot reproduce the asymmetrical drawer widths, rounded solid-wood profiles, leg taper, recessed joins, hardware profile, or part-specific grain direction visible in the reference.

detailInventory.note: Direct visual inventory of the authoritative desk concept. Each entry maps to an exact component localFeature or material localOverride in desk-sculpt-spec.json.

details.description: The tabletop uses a large rounded-rectangle plan radius, especially legible at the front corners, rather than a thin-box corner radius clamped by slab thickness.
details.scale: meso; plan radius about 0.045 of desk width
details.affects: tabletop silhouette and corner highlight flow

details.description: A broad softened perimeter roll connects the top plane to the darker vertical edge band and catches a continuous warm highlight.
details.scale: meso; bevel radius about 0.018 of desk width with 4 segments
details.affects: tabletop perimeter geometry and grazing-light response

details.description: Long irregular walnut grain runs primarily along the desk width, with subdued alternating amber and dark brown strands.
details.scale: macro-to-micro; broad plank flow plus fine directional strands
details.affects: top albedo, roughness, and tangent-space normal direction

details.description: The tabletop vertical edge band reads darker and denser than the top face, with stronger grain contrast at the rounded front edge.
details.scale: meso perimeter mask; 0.02 to 0.04 of tabletop depth

details.description: A narrow dark reveal separates the overhanging tabletop from the drawer rail across the full visible front.
details.scale: micro-to-meso; recessed line about 0.006 of desk height
details.affects: tabletop-to-carcass construction read and ambient occlusion

details.description: The center drawer is approximately twice either side drawer width, creating a wide-center and narrow-side rhythm rather than three equal fronts.
details.affects: drawer assembly proportions and front silhouette

details.description: Each drawer front is a shallow rounded rectangle with a soft raised edge highlight and rounded corners.
details.scale: meso; corner radius about 0.14 of drawer height and bevel about 0.025 of drawer height

details.description: Thin dark recessed gaps outline all three drawer fronts and remain readable beneath the soft edge highlight.
details.scale: micro; gap width about 0.01 of drawer height
details.affects: drawer separation, cavity shadow, and panel depth

details.description: Drawer-front grain follows the long horizontal axis of each front and remains individually phase-shifted across the three panels.
details.scale: micro; directional strands and low-frequency tonal bands
details.affects: drawer albedo, normal, and roughness orientation

details.description: Three centered brass knobs use a short neck and thick domed circular crown, clearly resolved in the lower-left close-up.
details.scale: micro repeated assembly; crown diameter about 0.27 of drawer height
details.affects: knob geometry, centered spacing, and attachment depth

details.description: The upper-left crown of each brass knob carries a compact warm specular highlight while the rim remains darker.
details.affects: brass crown roughness and clearcoat response

details.description: Brown-gold mottling and darker tarnish collect near the knob rim and lower crown instead of reading as uniform yellow metal.
details.scale: micro; irregular low-frequency crown mask with rim bias
details.affects: brass albedo, roughness, and cavity response

details.description: All four legs are broad beneath the apron and taper downward toward smaller rounded feet; the taper must not be reversed.
details.scale: macro; foot cross-section about 0.62 of upper-leg cross-section
details.affects: leg silhouette, stance, and open negative space

details.description: Leg corners carry a restrained soft radius that preserves a square furniture cross-section while avoiding sharp box edges.
details.scale: meso; radius about 0.1 of upper-leg width with 3 segments
details.affects: leg edge highlights and rounded foot transition

details.description: Leg and stile grain runs vertically from apron to floor, distinct from the horizontal grain on top and drawers.
details.affects: frame albedo, normal direction, and roughness breakup

details.description: Dark cavity response collects below the tabletop, around drawer recesses, at apron-leg joins, and beneath the cabinet without becoming a uniform black outline.
details.scale: meso contact masks with micro crevice bias
details.affects: frame ambient occlusion, depth separation, and joint grounding

anatomy.note: Not applicable: the target is furniture in the object domain.

definitionOfDone: A reference-matched front-right three-quarter render reaches at least 0.85 overall AI-vision fidelity and every critical semantic feature reaches at least 0.82.

The desk reads immediately as the concept through its thick rounded overhanging top, wide-center/narrow-side drawer hierarchy, four correctly downward-tapered legs, three aged-brass mushroom knobs, and open under-apron negative space.
Walnut surfaces show part-specific directional grain, independent albedo/roughness/normal/AO responses, rounded edge highlights, and localized cavity darkening without a flat plastic appearance.
The model remains an action-ready plain Three.js Group hierarchy with independent drawer pivots, knob attachments, named sockets, colliders, and stable component IDs.

featureGroups.name: Desk silhouette, stance, and negative space
qualityCriteria: The visible width:height ratio, tabletop depth, cabinet shallowness, and under-apron opening match the reference camera.
The top overhang remains visible beyond all four legs and the rear legs remain legible without widening the stance.

featureGroups.name: Rounded solid-wood tabletop profile

featureGroups.name: Wide-center drawer hierarchy and recessed reveals
qualityCriteria: The center drawer is about 2.15 times either side drawer width and all three faces share a common baseline.
Rounded fronts, narrow shadow gaps, and the rail beneath the tabletop remain separately readable.
failureModes: three drawer fronts are equal width
drawer gaps are painted lines

featureGroups.name: Downward-tapered leg set and cabinet joinery
qualityCriteria: Each leg starts broad under the cabinet and narrows toward a softly rounded foot with a foot cross-section near 0.62 of the upper section.
Legs connect through explicit sockets beneath the cabinet with no gaps, floating roots, or reversed taper.
failureModes: legs widen toward the floor
legs float below the apron
legs are uniform sharp boxes

featureGroups.name: Three aged-brass mushroom knob assemblies
qualityCriteria: Three knobs remain centered on their respective drawer fronts and use a short neck plus domed circular crown profile.
Brass separates crown highlight, darker rim, and mottled tarnish with metalness preserved.
failureModes: knobs read as flat discs or spheres
knob spacing follows equal drawer widths
brass is uniform yellow plastic

featureGroups.name: Part-specific walnut grain and tactile response
qualityCriteria: Top and drawer grain run horizontally while leg and stile grain run vertically, each with deterministic low-frequency color bands and fine directional normal detail.
Albedo, roughness, normal/height, and AO are independent channels, with localized edge and cavity overrides.
failureModes: same isotropic noise covers every part
grain direction ignores component axis
wood reads as flat brown plastic

featureGroups.name: Warm grazing light and grounded contact shadows
qualityCriteria: One warm upper-left shadow-casting key reveals bevels, grain relief, and knob crowns; restrained fill retains dark-green background contrast.
Contact shadows ground all feet and cabinet joins without near fog or ambient wash flattening the value range.
failureModes: ambient-only illumination flattens the model
multiple hard shadow keys exceed the approved budget

tabletop plan-corner radius, slab thickness, overhang, and perimeter roll
side:center:side drawer width ratio and common alignment
leg top-to-foot taper ratio, stance, and visible rear-leg separation
knob count, centered placement, stem/crown profile, and aged brass response
grain direction and scale per top, drawer, apron, stile, and leg
drawer reveal depth, under-top shadow line, joinery AO, and foot contact shadows

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not implement the tabletop with a rounded-box radius constrained by its thickness; use a plan-profile extrusion or equivalent geometry with independent corner radius.
Do not represent the front as three equal drawers; preserve the approximately 1.0:2.15:1.0 visible width ratio.
Do not reverse the leg taper; upper cross-sections must remain broader than feet.
Do not paint drawer gaps or tabletop edge rolls solely into albedo; visible relief requires geometry and cavity AO.
Do not reuse one wood texture orientation across all components; orient grain in each component's construction axis.
Do not reuse albedo as roughness, normal, height, or AO, and do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro frequency bands.
Do not merge drawers, knobs, or legs into the root mesh; keep stable action-ready pivots and attachment contracts.
Do not accept a pass below 0.85 overall AI-vision fidelity or below 0.82 for any critical feature.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Instance compatible repeated geometry, share four materials, dispose all geometry/material/texture resources, and preserve reference-critical silhouette and material bands while staying within approved limits.

lightingFromPhoto: key light: one shadow-casting warm area/directional key from upper-left-front, direction [-0.55,-0.75,0.35], color #FFD2A0, relative intensity 3.1, broad 2.4-unit emitter, soft PCF shadow; this is the only shadow-casting light
fill light: non-shadow-casting cool-neutral hemisphere or very broad fill from camera-right, color #9FB5A5, relative intensity 0.38; retain drawer and under-apron depth
environment/rim: dark-green low-intensity environment reflection #16271F with a restrained non-shadow rim from rear-right, color #B8C7AA, relative intensity 0.24 to separate rear legs
exposure and tone mapping: ACES filmic tone mapping, exposure 0.92, physicallyCorrectLights true, highlight rolloff preserving brass crown and tabletop bevel detail
background and contact shadow: matte dark-green background #0F211A; one soft ground receiver at Y=0 with foot contact shadows and localized AO, no near fog and no ambient-only wash
proceduralStrategy: Block out the 3.60 x 1.78 x 1.34 envelope, tabletop overhang, shallow apron, and four-leg stance before materials.
Use a rounded-rectangle Shape extrusion for tabletop plan radius so slab thickness cannot clamp the corners.
Create drawer fronts as three independent rounded extrusions at 1.0:2.15:1.0 widths with true recessed gaps and +Z slide pivots.
Generate one downward-tapered square-prism leg profile and reuse it at four sockets with per-instance grain phase.
Generate one 24-segment lathe knob profile and reuse it three times with per-instance tarnish masks.
Synthesize 2048-target component-aware walnut channels using 0.774-confidence extracted evidence; keep albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO independent.
Use 0.823-confidence aged-brass evidence for metal response while preserving the single-image inference limitation.
Optimize only after reference, neutral, and grazing renders meet 0.85 overall and 0.82 critical feature gates.
animationAnchors: tabletop-slab is the whole-desk root pivot for translation, rotation, scale, and visibility
drawer-left, drawer-bank, and drawer-right expose independent +Z linear-slide pivots limited to 0.30 units
each knob remains parented to its drawer so hardware follows drawer motion
all four legs retain cabinet-contact pivots and named attachment sockets
destructionAnchors: actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup marks detachable or breakable component sets
component seams and sockets define plausible break points instead of random explosions
